services.name: 2-Hour Jet Ski Tour
services.desc: Join us for the most fun tour available on Martha’s Vineyard. This 2 hour guided tour starts in Oak Bluff’s were you will follow your guide out of the harbor toward Edgartown. Enroute your guide will give you insight about the island from vantage points no bus tour can match. Along the way you will see Oak Bluff’s Edgartown and even Cape Pogue on Chappiquidick Island. There you will get to enjoy a relaxing time on the beach before zipping back to Oak Bluff’s. This tour departs at 8AM and returns at 10AM. Available Times Everyday 8AM 2 Daily at 8am! • Ages 2+

quotes.author: Ashley S • Yelp
quotes.text: My family and I rented a banana boat for the first time ever and we loved it so much we went back the next day. The staff is fantastic and accommodating while making sure everyone is having fun while being safe. I highly recommend this business.

quotes.author: Jeffrey W • Yelp
quotes.text: Boats be wild, but with MVO they make it nice and easy for you. I was really blown away by how chill and friendly this bunch was! Super great and well knowledgeable about the boat and surrounding areas. What a blast we had!

quotes.author: Toria H • Yelp
quotes.text: Highly recommend this place for water sport rentals! I did the 2-person jet ski and it was an amazing experience! the trainer was great and everything went so smoothly

quotes.author: Jenny C • Yelp
quotes.text: We had a great time with Captain Mark on a private charter Labor Day weekend -he knows so much about the area and catered the boat trip to what we wanted -thank you !

quotes.author: Nancy P • Yelp
quotes.text: The banana boat ride was awesome - out BP pay drivers were great and made it fun - totally worth it and nice to have such great customer service!
